definitions.explanation: Money paid in excess of what was actually owed. Most often refers to interest overpaid on consumer loans that the borrower can legally reclaim.

examples.japanese: {過払|かはら}い{金|きん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}す→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧。
{過払|かはら}い{金|きん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{返還|へんかん}→返還：14357_henkan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{請求|せいきゅう}した→請求する：26988_seikyuusuru⟧。
examples.english: I filed a claim for a refund of the overpayment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{弁護士|べんごし}→弁護士：03150_bengoshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{過払|かはら}い{金|きん}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}した→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧。
examples.english: I consulted a lawyer about overpaid interest.

notes:
A legal and financial term. In Japan it became widely known through claims to recover interest charged above the legal cap by consumer-finance lenders.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {過払|かはら}い{金|きん}⟦{請求|せいきゅう}→請求：03374_seikyuu⟧: a claim for overpaid money
- {過払|かはら}い{金|きん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{返還|へんかん}→返還：14357_henkan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to refund an overpayment
- {過払|かはら}い{金|きん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧: an overpayment arises
